en.sayed-ali-raza: All praise is due to Allāh even though time has brought (for us) crushing calamity and great occurrence.

And I stand witness that there is no god but Allāh the One, there is no partner for Him nor is there with Him any god other than Himself, and that Muhammad is His slave and His Prophet (May Allāh’s blessing and greeting be upon him and his progeny).
